missing_evidence: Redis-side telemetry (latency, timeouts, saturation) for the same window to confirm the timeout origin
Gateway/order error-rate and p95 metrics for the alert window to confirm alert alignment
candidates.statement: Inventory's Redis dependency is timing out: inventory logs show 6 redis_operation_timeout errors (status 504) and inventory metrics show 9 dependency_timeouts with p95 760ms, while gateway traces show a 1943ms ERROR span on call inventory. This bounded Redis timeout path is the evidence-supported cause of the checkout latency/error alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment of inventory 3.3.9 (6 min old) is recorded but not established as causal; Redis-side data absent.

report.explanation: Inventory shows Redis operation timeouts (6 errors, 9 dependency timeouts, p95 760ms) and gateway traces show a 1943ms ERROR on call inventory, supporting a bounded redis-timeout candidate. Gateway/order metrics and logs look healthy, so no broader gateway fault is claimed. Inventory 3.3.9 deployment is recorded but not proven causal.
